mapper.select: SELECT kr.id, kr.query_log_id AS queryLogId, kr.document_id AS documentId, kr.version_id AS versionId, kr.chunk_id AS chunkId, kr.chunk_index AS chunkIndex, kr.source, kr.created_at AS createdAt FROM knowledge_query_reference kr INNER JOIN knowledge_query_log kl ON kl.id = kr.query_log_id AND kl.tenant_id = #{tenantId} WHERE kr.query_log_id = #{logId} ORDER BY kr.created_at DESC
